Tests keyword extraction via YAKE algorithm

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractionConfig, KeywordConfig, ExtractInputKind, KeywordAlgorithm

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), uri="https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf")
    config = ExtractionConfig(keywords=KeywordConfig(algorithm=KeywordAlgorithm("yake"), max_keywords=10))
    result = await extract(input, config)
    for keyword in result.results[0].extracted_keywords or []:
        print(keyword.text)
        print(keyword.score)

asyncio.run(main())
```
